metadata.note: Two 3-into-1 manifolds, one per bank (cylinders 1-3 left, 4-6 right; firing 1-6-2-4-3-5 alternates the banks), their primaries unequal (0.47, 0.35 and 0.23 m are estimates). The car's cross tube, which takes the right bank's exhaust to the left turbine, is not written: with it the sound was noise (K, 2026-11-21, by ear), so each bank feeds its own turbine. The left and right KKK K26 turbines (housing size 6, 6 cm2: 27.6 mm) are written in the one form of every turbine here: the throat, 0.08 m long, and a room 0.11 m long and 150 mm wide after it, where the throat's stream loses its head as it does to the wheel. A 56 mm pipe from each turbine (0.52 and 0.62 m, estimates) into the one silencer, written as two rooms joined by a 70 mm pipe (the division is this model's; no dimension of the silencer was found); its two outlets (56 mm, not confirmed) are written as one of their combined area. No catalyst. Lengths are estimates; the silencer's widths were set by ear. Layout from Porsche's 959 parts catalogue, 1987-88, as read by the stage auditor, not read here. Valve: two exhaust valves per cylinder, 33 mm each (an estimate from the 928 four-valve head whose valve seat the 959 shares), written as one valve of their combined area, 46.7 mm; open about 260 deg (an estimate).
